rounds.text: The Ravalgaon Sugar Farm Ltd presents a concerning financial profile characterized by severe operational inefficiency and a complete collapse in sales growth [E13]. The company is currently destroying shareholder value, evidenced by a deeply negative return on equity of -47.8% and a return on assets of -34.34%, both of which significantly underperform their respective sector benchmarks [E7, E8]. Despite these poor fundamentals, the stock trades at a premium price-to-book ratio of 3.22x, which is notably higher than the sector benchmark of 1.64x [E1, E6]. Cash flow generation is equally problematic, with both operating and free cash flow recorded at negative Rs 2.46 Cr for March 2026 [E28, E29]. Furthermore, the company’s reliance on debt is increasing, with borrowings rising to Rs 3.47 Cr from Rs 2.52 Cr in the prior year [E31]. Conceded: the company has shown recent signs of improvement with a year-over-year net profit increase of 11% and accelerating earnings growth [E43, E45].
